notes.note: **Updated icons:** Enjoy a fresh new look with updated icons.
**New gestures:** Open the Tab Tray and delete tabs faster with new gestures.
**Smoother experience:** Bug fixes and improvements keep Firefox running smoothly and reliably.
**Quick answers:** Ask by voice and get a clear answer right from your New Tab. Now available for US English.
